author: Athul Prem
comparison_producer_policy: The pinned relation retains its executed source identity; this comparison records its own current producer separately.
power_units: Dimensionless power fraction per 1 W incident drive; the pair sum combines two separate drives.
scope: Two finite frequencies on the saved h80/z6 device, at original 0/16.65 micrometre end planes. Frequency differences are physical response variation in this discretized model, not a mesh-convergence test, numerical uncertainty bound, conversion mechanism or continuous-branch proof. All previous failed 1 GHz spatial comparisons remain failed; spatial and frequency convergence remain unresolved.
